meta.description: LLMWiki 开发任务注册表 — 多Agent协同开发追踪

agents.name: Review 可靠性修复
agents.description: Fix review state machine: strict status transitions, create/update discrimination, prevent silent skipped
acceptance: Accept update_page with missing target → error or auto-convert
Apply failures show specific error messages

agents.name: 知识图谱可视化修复
agents.description: Fix blank graph canvas: render nodes + edges via ReactFlow/X6, add empty state guidance
acceptance: Graph displays nodes when data exists (even orphan nodes)
Empty state: 'No graph data yet. Import documents to build knowledge graph.'
Node click navigates to related wiki page

agents.name: UI 美化 & 空状态引导
agents.description: Polish Tailwind theme, add transitions, fix empty state guidance across all views
acceptance: Each empty view shows actionable next step

agents.name: 去重系统集成
agents.description: Wire dedup_service into wiki update pipeline, prevent duplicate entities/concepts
acceptance: Wiki update agent checks for duplicates before creating pages
Duplicate entities show merge suggestion in review
Dedup uses strsim fuzzy matching with configurable threshold

agents.name: 文件浏览器增强
agents.description: Add right-click context menu, keyboard navigation, real-time search filter
acceptance: Right-click: Open / View AI Log / Copy Path / Show in Explorer
Search input filters tree in real-time
